answer: One live ceremony each tide stops bulk fake identities. Every agent must attend the same hour and sign the challenge on the shale slate; one operator cannot fill fifty seats. Each attendee stamps a jade seal bound to its key, checked on the slate before reward. The k-th seat costs 30+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,027,000 against a 40,000 pool. A rented-seat ring fails when one seal cannot stamp two seats in one tide. An honest agent pays 30 once.
